name: global-search

variants.notes: At 80x24 the modal's bottom hint line is truncated by the primitive: the title and body fit but 'Esc to close · Enter: insert · ↑↓' does not, so 'Esc' appears nowhere on screen. That is correct narrow-terminal behaviour, not a regression - the 120x40 variant pins the hint's presence and spelling, this variant pins only that the surface still renders. Narrow-terminal hint elision is tracked as Wave 4 item 4.5.

notes: Ctrl+P also opens it but ctrl+p is NOT a token, so /search (and its /find alias) is the reachable opener. Pins the titled-border chrome, a different border style from the rounded popups elsewhere — a good palette-regression canary.
